title: Super Mario All-Stars + Super Mario World - Alternate Luigi
description:
Don't like Luigi's strange move sets?
Well now he will use Mario's movesets so now you can enjoy Luigi with his brothers actual movesets. I also fixed his super duck holding pose ;)
Credits to Marioblender.

Now fixes some of Luigi's frames.

Moderator edit: fixed and improved soaring frames, and made some others look more like Mario's poses.
